metadata.name: polybaskets_escrow
metadata.description: AlphaBasket v2 internal-share accounting and backend-authorized settlement program

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Accepts administrator authority as the proposed key.

instructions.name: accrue_management_fee
docs: Permissionless crank; dilution is proportional to exact elapsed seconds.

instructions.name: attest_perp_event
docs: Records an autonomous Phoenix event. Callable unprompted, with no prior
AlphaBasket-initiated request and no matching trade receipt.

accounts.name: basket
docs: Read-only. An autonomous event changes Phoenix's view of the position, but
this program has no verified post-event margin or entry price to write —
those come from a vault-delta read, which only the settlement path performs.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: `init`, never `init_if_needed`: the same event observed twice — over both
the trader-state stream and the notification stream, for instance —
records once.

instructions.name: begin_reconstitution
docs: Moves an eligible perpetual basket into reconstitution.

instructions.name: begin_resolution
docs: Stops deposits and starts resolution for a non-perpetual basket.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_transfer
docs: Cancels a pending administrator transfer.

instructions.name: complete_deposit
docs: Completes a user-signed deposit after external Polymarket execution.

instructions.name: complete_phoenix_trade
docs: Records an already-executed, vault-delta-verified Phoenix trade and
updates the composition item it belongs to.

accounts.name: basket
docs: Mutable, but only one item's fields move.
`Basket.items` is the live composition. A settlement finds the one `Perp`
item for its market and updates that item in place; `composition_hash`,
`composition_version` and every other item are left exactly as they were,
because a fill is not a composition change.
Boxed: `Account<'info, T>` holds its deserialized `T` in the instruction's
stack frame, and a 16-item composition does not fit in 4096 bytes
alongside the rest of this context.

accounts.name: trader_registry
docs: Proves the execution wallet was onboarded to Phoenix exactly once.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: `init`, never `init_if_needed`: a second attempt to record the same
execution fails in the runtime.

instructions.name: complete_protocol_fee_withdrawal
docs: Redeems accrued protocol dilution shares after external execution.

instructions.name: complete_reconstitution
docs: Applies a new Composer-signed canonical composition.

instructions.name: complete_withdrawal
docs: Completes both an active early exit and a final redemption.

instructions.name: create_basket
docs: Only the configured Composer Service key can create a basket.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes the singleton configuration under the program upgrade authority.

instructions.name: onboard_trader_account
docs: One-time registration of a Phoenix trader account for an execution wallet.

accounts.name: registry
docs: `init`, never `init_if_needed`: onboarding the same wallet twice fails in
the runtime, which is the guarantee this account exists to provide.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Starts the two-step administrator transfer.

instructions.name: publish_composition_draft
docs: Publishes a creator-selected weighted composition in a size-safe prior transaction.

instructions.name: publish_eligibility_list
docs: Publishes a short-lived Composer-screened prediction-market list.

instructions.name: publish_perp_eligibility_list
docs: Publishes the Composer-screened Phoenix perpetual market list.

instructions.name: record_final_settlement
docs: Records the final NAV and share snapshot for deterministic redemptions.

instructions.name: register_token
docs: Adds, updates, disables, or re-enables a Jupiter spot-token allowlist entry.

instructions.name: set_authorities
docs: Rotates operational signer and treasury authorities.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: Updates the global user slippage bound.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pauses or resumes user and execution completion flows.

instructions.name: submit_price_attestation
docs: Records a fresh Composer-signed TWAP for a signed-fallback spot token.

types.name: AttestPerpEventArgs
docs: An autonomous Phoenix action. Callable unprompted, with no matching trade.

types.name: Basket
docs: Basket composition, lifecycle, and aggregate share accounting.

types.name: BasketAsset
docs: One weighted asset in a Composer-signed basket composition.

types.name: BasketStatus
docs: Lifecycle states for a basket.

types.name: CompleteDepositArgs
docs: User intent and backend result used to complete a deposit. The gross amount
and minimum shares are user-authorized; `net_deposit_value` is the actual
value credited by external execution and backs the minted shares.

types.name: CompletePhoenixTradeArgs
docs: An already-executed, vault-delta-verified Phoenix trade.
Every figure was computed off chain and read back from real post-execution
Phoenix state. This program validates and records; it computes no NAV, no fees
and no PnL.

fields.name: expected_composition_version
docs: Bound the same way `complete_deposit` binds: the basket's live
`composition_version`. The hash is checked as well, because unlike a
deposit this instruction writes into `items`.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Phoenix market symbol, read live from exchange metadata by the backend.

fields.name: actual_margin_posted_units
docs: Collateral actually resident in the isolated subaccount after execution.

fields.name: entry_mark_price
docs: Entry price of the resulting position. Zero means "no position left to
price" and is accepted only on a close.

types.name: CompleteProtocolFeeWithdrawalArgs
docs: Backend result used to redeem protocol-owned dilution shares. The gross
realized value is the actual external execution value.

types.name: CompleteWithdrawalArgs
docs: User intent and backend result used to complete a withdrawal. The share
amount and minimum value are user-authorized; `gross_realized_value` is the
actual external execution value used for fee and proceeds accounting.

types.name: CompositionDraft
docs: Composer-published creator selection. Splitting variable-size items into a
prior transaction keeps create/reconstitution transactions under Solana's
packet limit without weakening Ed25519 authorization.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton protocol configuration and authority registry.

types.name: CreateBasketArgs
docs: Composer-authorized basket creation parameters.

types.name: EligibilityList
docs: Short-lived Composer-published market list used by basket creation/reconstitution.

types.name: EligibleMarket
docs: One prediction market admitted by the Composer's unchanged six-point screen.
Weights are deliberately absent: creators choose them after eligibility is signed.

types.name: FinalSettlementArgs
docs: Final basket NAV and share-supply snapshot.

types.name: InitializeArgs
docs: Initialization parameters for operational authorities and accounting policy.

types.name: OnboardTraderAccountArgs
docs: One-time Phoenix onboarding record for an execution wallet.

types.name: PerpDirection
docs: Direction of a perpetual position.
A dedicated enum rather than a bool or a signed size: a bool has no natural
reading ("true" is not obviously long), and a signed magnitude conflates
direction with size, so a zero-size position would have no direction at all.

types.name: PerpEligibilityList
docs: Short-lived Composer-published perpetual market list, the perp counterpart to
`EligibilityList`. Seeded at `b"perp_eligibility"` so it cannot collide with
the prediction-market list at `b"eligibility"`.

types.name: PerpEligibleMarket
docs: One Phoenix perpetual market the Composer has admitted.
Deliberately not `EligibleMarket`: that type's `outcome` and `ctf_token_id`
are Polymarket/CTF fields with no meaning for a perpetual, and spot has its own
`TokenAllowlist`. Weights are absent for the same reason as `EligibleMarket` —
creators choose them after eligibility is signed.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Phoenix market symbol, e.g. "SOL". Read live from Phoenix exchange metadata.

types.name: PerpEventAttestation
docs: Record of an autonomous Phoenix action against a basket position.
Seeds: `[b"perp_event", event_hash]`.

fields.name: detail_hash
docs: Hash of the full Phoenix event payload, which is too large and too
venue-specific to store on chain.

types.name: PerpEventKind
docs: The kind of unprompted action Phoenix took on a position.
Phoenix's own wire names are `adl` and `risk_engine_cancel_order`.

types.name: PerpFillStatus
docs: Outcome of a Phoenix execution, derived from post-execution position state.
There is deliberately no `Rejected` variant. A rejected order posted no margin
and opened no position, so there is nothing to settle: the backend surfaces it
as a failure and never reaches `complete_phoenix_trade`. Accepting `Rejected`
here would create a receipt asserting a trade happened when it did not.

types.name: PerpSettlementReceipt
docs: Immutable record of one already-executed Phoenix trade.
Seeds: `[b"perp_receipt", execution_hash]`.
Named and seeded apart from `SettlementReceipt`, which records accounting
settlements at `[b"receipt", execution_batch_hash]` and has an unrelated shape.

fields.name: actual_margin_posted_units
docs: Read from post-execution Phoenix state, never from a quote.

fields.name: entry_mark_price
docs: Read from post-execution Phoenix state, never from a quote.

types.name: PerpTradeSide
docs: Whether a recorded Phoenix trade opened or closed a position.

fields.name: actual_margin_posted_units
docs: Read from post-execution Phoenix state, never from a quote.

types.name: Position
docs: A user's shares, performance-fee basis, and weighted holding timestamp.
`cost_basis_value` is the aggregate HWM/equalization basis of the remaining
shares. Partial redemptions remove only their proportional basis; they do
not raise the per-share basis of unredeemed shares unless those shares also
crystallize a performance fee.

types.name: PositionKind
docs: Tagged representation of a supported basket position.
Adding `Perp` does not change `PositionKind::INIT_SPACE`: the variant is 20
bytes against `PredictionMarket`'s 33, so the maximum is unchanged and no
existing `Basket` or `CompositionDraft` needs a realloc.

fields.name: phoenix_subaccount
docs: Phoenix isolated subaccount index. Always greater than zero;
subaccount 0 is Phoenix's cross-margin account and is never used to
hold a position.

types.name: PriceAttestation
docs: Latest Composer-signed TWAP fallback for a token without a robust oracle.

fields.name: price_value
docs: Six-decimal settlement-value price, matching the accounting engine.

types.name: ReconstitutionArgs
docs: Composer-authorized replacement composition.

types.name: SettlementAction
docs: Settlement receipt operation type.

types.name: SettlementReceipt
docs: Immutable replay-protected record of a completed accounting settlement.

fields.name: execution_version
docs: Version of the canonical external-execution batch encoding.

fields.name: execution_batch_hash
docs: Hash of all fill markets, outcomes, amounts, prices, and external references.

fields.name: executed_at
docs: Timestamp at which the external execution batch completed.

fields.name: gross_value
docs: Actual value credited for a deposit or realized for a withdrawal.

types.name: TokenAllowlist
docs: Admin-maintained spot-token registry. Disabling an entry blocks new
compositions but never changes or liquidates an existing basket.

types.name: TraderAccountRegistry
docs: Proof that an execution wallet was onboarded to Phoenix exactly once.
Seeds: `[b"perp_trader", execution_wallet]`.

types.name: WithdrawalKind
docs: Whether a redemption occurs while active or against a final snapshot.
